svg.title: Twenty-one reads, or three
svg.desc: Two ways to index two million part numbers on disk. Left: a binary tree with one part number per node, about twenty-one levels deep, so a lookup reads twenty-one places on the disk. Right: a B-tree whose nodes are whole disk blocks of about two hundred keys each: one block at the top, two hundred below it, forty thousand below those, enough for eight million parts in three reads.
svg.text: Leonard's index: about 21 seeks for a binary search or a balanced binary tree; 3 for the B-tree.
